reason: Some ALFRED H4.1 date list entries produce Federal Reserve direct dated-page HTTP 404. ALFRED includes dates when any series was revised, which are not guaranteed to map to a published H41 page at /releases/h41/YYYYMMDD/.
policy: A 404 for an individual FED page must produce SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with date/URL and no numeric values; continue processing other listed candidates. Never infer Thursday substitution, invent numerical values or mark a source PASS. Fail the research combine if accepted coverage below 600 releases; flag gaps and refuse stale macro features.
sourceIntegrity: Archive all successful HTTP response bytes with R2 SHA, never fabricate 404 content. 404 rows remain in year manifest as blocked reason and count. 4-release feature requires 21-day no-gap rule.
unchanged: Prior v8.10/a/b numerical parser sample cases, lag, research only, no trading writes.
